desc: Derive correct reduction: answer = S + reverse(S[:n-L]) where L = longest palindromic suffix of S; verified on samples (ABC→ABCBA, TREE→TREERT, Z→Z).
Choose algorithm: KMP prefix function over reverse(S) + '#' + S; pi[-1] = L. O(n) time and memory.
Implement final program with fast I/O (sys.stdin.buffer), KMP over bytes for speed, output S + S[:n-L][::-1].
Verify edge cases: n=1, S already palindrome (L=n, append empty), all-same-character string (e.g., "AAAA" → L=4 → output unchanged).
